Consolidated Core revenue

corresponding period of 2024. This solid performance was principally supported by the continued expansion of the Enterprise Solutions segment. Unit : mn

## Page 21

Financial Performance 
21 
Consolidated Net Proﬁt and Net Proﬁt Margin 
In Q3/2025, the Company recorded a net profit attributable to shareholders of 
THB 407 million, representing a significant year-on-year increase of THB 391 
million from THB 16 million in Q3/2024. This performance reflects a strong 
recovery in profitability and a clear improvement in operating leverage. 
The substantial growth was driven by stronger gross profit generation across 
core business segments, particularly product sales and government 
contracting projects, supported by improved gross margins. This was 
complemented by tighter cost discipline, as selling and administrative 
expenses declined year-on-year, alongside lower financial costs, which further 
reinforced bottom-line performance. 
For the first nine months of 2025, net profit rose to THB 590 million, compared to 
THB 205 million in the same period last year, underscoring the Group’s solid 
earnings momentum. 
Overall, the improved net profit trajectory highlights the Company’s enhanced 
earnings quality, operational efficiency, and strengthened financial 
fundamentals, reinforcing its position for sustainable growth and long-term 
value creation. 
Unit : mn 
+2,444% YoY

## Page 22

Financial Performance 
22 
Total Asset 
As of 30 September 2025, total assets increased to THB 12,952 million, up THB 815 million 
or 7% from year-end 2024, driven mainly by higher trade receivables in line with stronger 
revenue recognition from the Enterprise Solutions segment. 
The rise in current assets was partially offset by a reduction in advance payments as 
prior prepayments for aircraft and specialized vehicles were converted into delivered 
assets. Overall, the asset expansion reflects disciplined growth and efficient working 
capital deployment, supporting the Company’s earnings momentum. 
Capital Structure Unit : mn 
Unit : mn 
As of 30 September 2025, total liabilities amounted to THB 9,010 million, increasing 
slightly by THB 79 million or 1% from year-end 2024. This reflects prudent liquidity 
management and higher short-term borrowings to support working capital, while 
advances from customers declined in line with completed deliveries during Q3. 
Meanwhile, shareholders’ equity rose significantly to THB 3,942 million, up THB 736 
million, primarily driven by strong net profit for the period. This improvement reinforces a 
stronger capital structure and highlights the Company’s enhanced financial stability, 
providing a solid foundation for sustainable growth going forward.
